description: Discover the eligibility criteria for obtaining a visa for parents in Dubai. Explore the requirements to bring your parents to Dubai.

contentHtml:
You can apply visa for parents in Dubai if you are contemplating bringing your parents to the Emirate Dubai. With this visa, you can reside with your parents for a long time and thus strengthen your family ties. Additionally, you can apply for and sponsor the visa if you are a son, daughter, daughter-in-law, or son-in-law.

In this article, you will see how this type of visa works and what the process is like to sponsor it. In the same way, you will know the terms for eligibility and conditions of the residence visa for parents.

Navigating the visa Process for parents in Dubai

With the parent visa Dubai, you will be able to sponsor your parents in Dubai and the rest of the UAE. In this case, the requirements you will need regarding your income will be specific and high. Therefore, economic stability will be guaranteed to protect your parents or elders.

In the same way, with these conditions, the Emirate emphasizes the importance of value and respect for the family unit. Likewise, it benefits the families of foreigners in that you will be able to have your loved ones close to you. This way, you will ensure that your parents have a safe and comfortable travel with a visa in Dubai.

Eligibility criteria for parent visa in Dubai

The basic criteria for the visa for parents in Dubai and the family visa, include a good income and medical tests, among others. Next, you will see in detail what these eligibility criteria are:

Financial stability

As we mentioned, one of the conditions to sponsor your parents is to prove that you have sufficient and stable financial resources. In this case, these resources must cover all the needs that their parents may have when they are residing in the Emirate.

Generally, this means that you must present certificates that guarantee your good income. Likewise, you must present proof of stable employment through recent payrolls as well as documents related to this.

Minimum salary requirement

Another important requirement for the parent visa Dubai is that you have a minimum salary of AED 20000 per month. However, currently, the amount for parent sponsorship has been reduced to AED 10,000.

Relationship documentation

You should bring both of your parents because if you do not, you will have to present the divorce, death, or any other valid certificate. In this case, the document will have to state a reasonable reason for applying for the visa in Dubai. Also, the certificates must be approved by the Embassy of the Emirates, by the country of origin, and by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs.

Additionally, all certificates must be submitted with a legal translation into Arabic as it is a requirement of the law.

Dependency certificate

You must present a certificate endorsed by the consulate of the country of origin, indicating your responsibility regarding the comprehensive well-being of your parents. Likewise, the dependency certificate must be presented in Arabic. Additionally, you must be accredited by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the United Arab Emirates.

Certified lease agreement

Another important eligibility requirement is the lease contract, which must have the approval of the Ejari. Similarly, you must present a registered tenant center and the electricity service bill if you reside in any other Emirate.

If the rental contract is not in your name, you will not be able to apply for a visa under any circumstances. In this case, this is one of the required documents essential for the parental visa.

Requirements for obtaining a parent visa in Dubai

Below you will see the specific list of all the documents you will need for the visa for parents in Dubai:

  • If you have a 10-year visa, you will submit the list of necessary documents.
  • The page of your clear passport and residence visa.
  • Photocopy of the passports of both parents in color and valid for at least 6 months.
  • Certificate of your birth legalized by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Emirates embassy in your country. It must then be certified by the UAE Ministry of Foreign Affairs. Likewise, it must be translated into Arabic.
  • Digital photograph of you with high image quality that matches that of the ICP.

Additionally, if the certificate is not available, you can obtain the letter in Arabic from the consulate of your country approving the relationship certified by MOFA. Additionally, if you belong to the following countries, you must present your national identification

  • Iran
  • Iraq
  • Afghanistan
  • Libya

Furthermore, according to the GDRFA, health insurance must be submitted compulsorily for all applications. You can choose from:

  • a DHA Basic Insurance
  • Comprehensive insurance

Steps to bring your parents to Dubai

To apply for the residence visa for parents in Dubai, both your parents must be physically present for the process. However, if this is not possible, then the UAE Embassy of your country and the UAE Ministry of Foreign Affairs will have to issue a certificate. Additionally, if you have a 2-year visa, you will have to present the affidavit of dependency.

In this statement, you will express your interest in taking responsibility for the health and general well-being of your parents. Additionally, you must have a home center or Ejari for the sponsored parent or parents. Similarly, Ejari or house must be 2BHK to be able to sponsor your parents.

Golden visa for parents in Dubai

This golden visa for parents in Dubai is ideal if you must take care of your elderly parents who are under your responsibility. In this case, the visa will make sponsorship in Dubai easier. The validity of this and the visa may vary. However, it is essential to renew the expired residence visa of your parents.

In this case, you must present up-to-date documents including proof of economic stability and rental arrangements. Additionally, you will have to present proof of having a valid relationship with your parents.

Likewise, the normal parents residence visa Dubai will give you the possibility to apply for a 1-year residence visa for parents. In the same way, it can be renewed annually. However, with the golden visa, you can obtain up to 10 years of residence for your parents as will be the case if you have the golden visa.

Visa costs for parents

For you to sponsor your parents, you must earn a minimum wage and have a health insurance policy for your parents with minimum coverage. At the same time, these policies must be renewed every year. Additionally, the price of visa services may vary, depending on the sponsor and duration. The fees are generally the same as for the family visa application.

On the other hand, the cost of services for the residence visa may depend on the conditions of the sponsor. In this case, this is if you are an Emirati citizen or have a valid residence visa and meet the minimum income required by law. Additionally, when submitting the visa application for your parents, you will need to pay the guarantee fee of AED 5,000.

Specific prices for the parents residence visa Dubai

As we mentioned in the previous section, the price of visa fees will vary depending on the visa sponsor. Below, you will be able to see a breakdown of each specific cost:

  • For 1 year new Parent Visa with a 2-year investor visa sponsor, the cost will be AED 8832.25.
  • The 1-year parent visa fee for a sponsor with a 2-year investor visa will be AED    50,575.
  • For 5-year Visas for new parents with a sponsor with the 5-year investor visa, the amount will be AED 5154.25.
  • Likewise, the payment to renew the 5-year parent visa that has a sponsor with the investor visa for 5 years will be AED 4242.25.
  • For the 5-year parent visa cancellation with a sponsor who has the 5-year investor visa, it will be AED 505.75.
  • Also, for a New Parent Investor Visa for 10 years with a sponsor with an Investor Visa for 10 years you will pay AED    6054. 25.
  • Renewing the 10-year principal investor visa that has a sponsor with a 10-year investor visa will pay AED 5,242.25.
  • Finally, for the cancellation of the investor visa for parents for 10 years with a sponsor investor visa for 10 years, you will pay AED 505.75

Age and eligibility criteria for residence visa for parents in Dubai

The residence visa for the parents can be requested through the Amer Center. In this case you will need to consider the restrictions regarding age. Likewise, you will have to meet the eligibility criteria required by law. Therefore, according to the law, there is a minimum age requirement for parents in Dubai.

These age criteria may vary depending on the specific laws applied by the authorities of the Emirate. Thus, if you are a foreign employee, you will be able to sponsor your parents for 1 year by paying the guarantee deposit for each of them. Similarly, it is stipulated by the immigration department of the United Arab Emirates.

Likewise, you must remember that you will not be able to sponsor only one of your parents, so both parents must sponsor themselves at the same time. However, if you wish to sponsor only one parent, you will have to present the NOC letter from another parent or mother who does not wish to travel.

How to apply for a UAE parental visa

You will be able to apply for a visa for parents in Dubai by following some simple guidelines, but first, you must check if you have the following complete requirements:

  • The documents necessary for the application.
  • Sending the documents for verification to [email protected] to apply online directly.
  • You can also call the DLD call center at 8004488 for more information.

Additionally, it is not necessary to physically go to the DLD-cube offices, because all the information will be available online.

If you are outside the country, can you apply for a Parent Visa?

To complete the visa application process for your parents, your physical presence is necessary, so during the process, you will not be able to travel outside of Dubai. Therefore, if you are not in the country you will not be able to apply for the visa in any way.

Tips for a Smooth Parent Visa Application Process

You now know the requirements and steps for applying for a visa for parents in Dubai. However, below, you can take some useful tips for the visa application process:

  • Know all the requirements well.
  • Prepare the complete documentation you will need.
  • Make sure the documents you need are up-to-date and accurately prepared.
  • Please inform yourself periodically about possible rate updates.
  • Start the renewal process before the visa expiration date to avoid potential last-minute complications.
  • Also, have a plan for medical exams.
  • Keep track of the validity of your visa and take advantage of the authorities of immigration online resources.
  • Additionally, if necessary, seek professional advice at an Amer Center.
  • Complete the visa application process on time and be patient and resolve any difficulties promptly.

Additionally, to be informed about visa updates in Dubai as well as fees, please consult directly with the staff at the nearest Amer Center.

Online Portals to Check Parent Visa Status Dubai

The UAE government has two main portals that you can use to check your visa status:

  • The web portal of the ICP or Federal Authority for Identity, Citizenship, Customs and Port Security.
  • Web portal of the General Directorate of Residency and Foreigners Affairs of Dubai (GDRFA).

Now you will see the simple steps to verify the visa status with your valid passport number:

  • Enter the ICP platform.
  • Choose Passport Information and then Visa Type.
  • Enter the passport number, expiration date of your passport, and nationality.
  • Do the captcha verification.
  • Select the Search button.

Also, to do the Dubai visa verification for your parents using the visa application number:

  • Enter the GDRFA portal.
  • Select File and write your name in the appropriate space, file number, your visa application number, nationality, and date of birth.
  • Complete the captcha verification.
  • Click the SEARCH button.

Additionally, there are alternative methods with which you can verify the visa:

  • Use an authorized Application.
  • You can use their phone by calling the ICP customer care center at +97124955555.
  • You can make your queries by sending your request to the email at [email protected].
  • Please submit your queries via the online inquiry form on the ICP website.
  • Finally, you can visit the ICP offices in person.

Likewise, for all methods, have the necessary documents on hand to make the process smoother.

In conclusion, the visa for parents in Dubaiis an easy document to apply for as long as it meets all the requirements of the law. Therefore, start by making sure you meet the requirements and know every step so you do not have any issues.

Also, if you have questions about the processes or any other concerns, contact us.
